prior.note: plan L2016 now calls debrisBurst for every opened site whatever pdt is, and breachSeen is still updated each frame (L2015). debrisBurst calls e.spawn directly (L1262-1267), so it does not depend on the step rate. Without the fix, the venting stream and hit smoke over the few frames after the hitstop cannot reach 14 particles, so the test tells the two versions apart.

gradeCover (L621-651) paints every floor/door tile and each wall's floor and band parts onto one art-pixel mask, then emits row runs. A run grows downward only when the row below has exactly the same start and end (key i*W+e, open/next maps), so no two output rects can overlap. All wallPicture offsets are even, so dividing by ART is exact. The duel flash at L1984 uses this same cover. The new test at L516-535 paints the cover onto cells and checks that each cell is painted exactly once and that the union equals the wall-picture parts, on both the Cutter and the Skiff.

stars(seed, band, t, artPx) (L1652-1662) snaps x and y to whole multiples of artPx from the band's corner, sizes each star artPx, and moves the layers at speed*artPx with STAR_LAYERS speeds 4 and 10. The draw at L2051 uses frame.artPx for the size, and both views pass artPx = 2*fit.scale (L2535, duel at L2771). The test runs at artPx 2, 4/3, 1.31 and 1, and checks the movement against speed*artPx. Spec note 5 (L3034) has been updated to match.
